intro: Karang Amakkar is an orc scout stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost along the rocky coast of Ashenvale. Operating on the fringe of Horde territory, he focuses on curbing the violent furbolg tribes that threaten the outpost's supply lines and borders. Adventurers travelling through the outpost rely on his local intelligence to navigate the perilous tensions of the forest.

p: Perched at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Zoram Strand, Karang Amakkar serves the Horde at one of its most vulnerable border outposts. The encampment faces constant pressure from the sea, the night elves, and wild beasts inland. Karang keeps a close eye on the hostile native populations that surround the road eastward, ensuring that Horde couriers and scouting parties do not get ambushed by territorial indigenous tribes.

Karang focuses much of his attention on the furbolg populations native to the ancient woods, notably the Foulweald tribe. With corruption and primal hostility driving these bear-folk into frenzies, Karang tasks capable warriors with culling their leader and clearing out dens before the tribes can muster organized assaults against Zoram'gar.
